items.informal_name: Formal Taylor Series Up to Order n Implies Up to Order m for m ≤ n
items.type:
∀ {𝕜 : Type u} [inst : NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type uE} [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [inst_2 : NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {F : Type uF} [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_4 : NormedSpace 𝕜 F] {f : E → F}
  {m n : WithTop ℕ∞} {p : E → FormalMultilinearSeries 𝕜 E F},
  HasFTaylorSeriesUpTo n f p → m ≤ n → HasFTaylorSeriesUpTo m f p
items.informal_description: If a function $ f : E \to F $ has a formal Taylor series expansion up to order $ n $, then for any $ m \leq n $, it also has a formal Taylor series expansion up to order $ m $. This follows from truncating the higher-order series to the lower order $ m $.

  {f : E → F} {m n : WithTop ℕ∞} {p : E → FormalMultilinearSeries 𝕜 E F},
  HasFTaylorSeriesUpToOn n f p s → m ≤ n → HasFTaylorSeriesUpToOn m f p s

items.type: {E : Type u_2} → [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] → [NormedSpace ℝ E] → (ℝ → E) → ℕ → Set ℝ → ℝ → E

This represents the scaled $ k $-th derivative contribution to the Taylor expansion of $ f $ at $ x_0 $ within the domain $ s $.

items.informal_name: Taylor Map Preserves Membership in DegreeLT Submodule
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {r : R} {n : ℕ} {f : Polynomial R},
  (Polynomial.taylor r) f ∈ Polynomial.degreeLT R n ↔ f ∈ Polynomial.degreeLT R n
items.informal_description: For a semiring $ R $ and natural number $ n $, the Taylor series expansion of a polynomial $ f $ at $ r $ lies in the submodule $ R[X]_n $ (consisting of polynomials with degree less than $ n $) if and only if $ f $ itself is in $ R[X]_n $.

items.informal_name: Evaluation of Sum of Iterated Derivatives with Factorial Coefficients
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [Nontrivial R] [NoZeroDivisors R] (p : Polynomial R) {q : ℕ},
  0 < q →
    ∃ gp,
      gp.natDegree ≤ p.natDegree - q ∧
        ∀ (r : R) {p' : Polynomial R},
          p = (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C r) ^ (q - 1) * p' →
            Polynomial.eval r (Polynomial.sumIDeriv p) =
              (q - 1).factorial • Polynomial.eval r p' + q.factorial • Polynomial.eval r gp
items.informal_description: For any polynomial $ p $ over a commutative ring $ R $ with no zero divisors and non-trivial, and for any positive integer $ q $, there exists a polynomial $ g_p $ with $\deg(g_p) \leq \deg(p) - q$ such that for any $ r \in R $ and any polynomial $ p' $ satisfying $ p = (X - r)^{q-1} p' $, the evaluation of the sum of iterated derivatives of $ p $ at $ r $ satisfies: $\operatorname{eval}_r(\sum_{i=0}^\infty \frac{d^i p}{dX^i}) = (q-1)! \cdot \operatorname{eval}_r(p') + q! \cdot \operatorname{eval}_r(g_p)$.

items.informal_description: If every element of a set $ S $ of real numbers satisfies $ x \leq 0 $, then the supremum of $ S $ satisfies $ \sup S \leq 0 $.

items.type: {α : Type u_1} [CompleteSemilatticeSup α] {s t : Set α} (h : s ⊆ t) : sSup s ≤ sSup t

items.name: sSup_le
items.type: {α : Type u_1} [CompleteSemilatticeSup α] {s : Set α} {a : α} (h : ∀ b ∈ s, b ≤ a) : sSup s ≤ a

items.name: sSup_le_iff
items.type: {α : Type u_1} [CompleteSemilatticeSup α] {s : Set α} {a : α} : sSup s ≤ a ↔ ∀ b ∈ s, b ≤ a

items.name: sSup_le_sSup_of_isCofinalFor
items.type: {α : Type u_1} [CompleteSemilatticeSup α] {s t : Set α} (h : IsCofinalFor s t) : sSup s ≤ sSup t

items.name: sSup_le_sSup_of_subset_insert_bot
items.type: {α : Type u_1} [CompleteLattice α] {s t : Set α} (h : s ⊆ insert ⊥ t) : sSup s ≤ sSup t

query: If every member of a set of real numbers is at most c and c is nonnegative then the supremum is at most c

items.name: Real.sSup_le
items.type: ∀ {s : Set ℝ} {a : ℝ}, (∀ x ∈ s, x ≤ a) → 0 ≤ a → sSup s ≤ a

items.name: Real.iSup_le
items.type: ∀ {ι : Sort u_1} {f : ι → ℝ} {a : ℝ}, (∀ (i : ι), f i ≤ a) → 0 ≤ a → ⨆ i, f i ≤ a

items.name: sup_le
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : SemilatticeSup α] {a b c : α}, a ≤ c → b ≤ c → a ⊔ b ≤ c

items.name: ciSup_le
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {ι : Sort u_4} [inst : ConditionallyCompleteLattice α] [Nonempty ι] {f : ι → α} {c : α},
  (∀ (x : ι), f x ≤ c) → iSup f ≤ c

items.name: Real.sSup_nonpos
items.type: ∀ {s : Set ℝ}, (∀ x ∈ s, x ≤ 0) → sSup s ≤ 0
